general_description.title: GENERAL DESCRIPTION
general_description.description: The 269C-1 is a lightweight, piston-powered helicopter derived from the Model 269C, designed for economical, reliable, and safe operation with lower life cycle costs, high payload-to-empty-weight ratio, improved crashworthiness, and multi-purpose capability.
key_points: Derivative of Model 269C configured for lower life cycle costs
FAA Type Certificate Number 4H12
Commercial designation: S-300CB (S/N 0001-0138), S-300CBi (S/N 0139 & Subs)
Flight plan designator: H269
Normal operations limited to visual flight conditions day or night
Certified in normal helicopter category per FAA regulations

airframe_and_structure.title: DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION DESCRIPTION
airframe_and_structure.description: The fuselage uses a central tubular steel open frame as the primary load-carrying structure. A monocoque aluminum tailboom extends rearward from the center frame. The cabin is formed by the canopy, two doors, floor section, and seat structure, enclosing the pilot and passenger area.
key_points: Central tubular steel open frame forms the load-carrying structure
Pilot's position is on the RIGHT side of the cabin
Instrument panel located forward of seats at helicopter centerline
Canopy and door transparent areas are cast acrylic material
Airfoil above canopy modifies airflow around the cabin
Glove box stowage compartment can accommodate up to 20 lbs additional baggage
28-volt accessory power plug below left side of instrument panel on later S/N aircraft
Tailboom is monocoque aluminum structure housing tail rotor drive shaft and control rod
Lower forward fairing streamlines below cabin and supports engine air induction system
components: Aluminum floor beams, channels, and panels
Seat structure (riveted aluminum beams, frames, bulkheads)

specifications.notes: Below left side of instrument panel on later S/N aircraft

landing_gear.title: DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION DESCRIPTION
landing_gear.description: Fixed skid-type nonretractable landing gear with fore and aft crossbeams attached to the underside of the center frame. Oleo-type shock-absorbing dampers are incorporated. Skid tubes at lower strut ends provide attachment points for ground handling wheels.
key_points: Skid type, nonretractable
Fore and aft crossbeams attach to underside of center frame
Oleo-type shock-absorbing dampers
Right and left stabilizer assemblies connect outboard ends of crossbeams
Stabilizer assemblies provide stepping areas for cabin entry and servicing
Skid tubes have attachment points for ground handling wheels

specifications.item: Main rotor clearance ground to tip (static)

main_rotor_system.title: DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION DESCRIPTION
main_rotor_system.description: Three-bladed, fully articulated single main rotor system with flapping hinges and lead-lag hinged blade attachment. The main rotor drive shaft transmits power from the main transmission to the hub. A thrust bearing positions the shaft within the nonrotating mast.
key_points: Three blades, fully articulated with flapping and lead-lag hinges
NACA 0015 airfoil
Blade twist of -8°39'
RPM limits: power on 442-471 rpm, power off 390-504 rpm
Main rotor mast secured to upper structural member of rear cabin bulkhead and rigidly attached to center frame by three structural members
Thrust bearing positions drive shaft within mast

tail_rotor_system.title: DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION DESCRIPTION
tail_rotor_system.description: Two-bladed antitorque tail rotor with variable-pitch blades interconnected by a high-strength tension-torsion strap assembly. Mounted on the output shaft of the tail rotor transmission at the aft end of the tailboom.
key_points: Two variable-pitch blades interconnected by tension-torsion strap assembly
NACA 0014 modified airfoil
Blade twist of -8°00'
RPM limits power on: 2901-3094 rpm
Provides torque reaction and directional control
components: Tail rotor drive shaft (one-piece, no intermediate couplings or bearings)
Drive shaft damper (near center of tailboom)

specifications.item: Collective pitch full left pedal (thrust right) at 3/4 radius
Collective pitch full right pedal (thrust left) at 3/4 radius

transmission_and_drive_system.title: DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION DESCRIPTION
transmission_and_drive_system.description: Engine power is transmitted via a belt drive transmission assembly using a matched set of V-belts between lower and upper pulleys. A pilot-controlled idler pulley acts as a clutch. The upper pulley incorporates an overrunning clutch for autorotation. The main transmission mounts on the lower end of the nonrotating mast and has a self-contained lubrication system cooled by airflow.
key_points: Belt drive assembly uses matched set of V-belts between lower (engine crankshaft) and upper (main transmission input) pulleys
Idler pulley controlled by pilot acts as engage/disengage clutch
Overrunning clutch in upper pulley permits autorotation without driving belts or engine
One-piece tail rotor drive shaft with no intermediate couplings or bearings
Drive shaft damper suppresses excessive oscillation during acceleration/deceleration
Main transmission has self-contained lubrication system, cooled by airflow
Tail rotor transmission has self-contained lubricant supply

powerplant.title: DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION DESCRIPTION
powerplant.description: Textron Lycoming four-cylinder, horizontally opposed, air-cooled engine. S/N 0001-0138 use the HO-360-C1A (carbureted with primer system); S/N 0139 & Subs use the HIO-360-G1A (fuel injected). Both rated at 180 hp at 2700 rpm for takeoff and maximum continuous operation at sea level standard conditions. Engine mounted horizontally on shock mounts within the center frame section.
key_points: HO-360-C1A (carbureted) for S/N 0001-0138; HIO-360-G1A (fuel injected) for S/N 0139 & Subs
180 hp at 2700 rpm for both takeoff AND maximum continuous (same rating)
Four-cylinder, horizontally opposed, air-cooled
Mounted horizontally on shock mounts within center frame
Carbureted version includes primer system
components: Textron Lycoming HIO-360-G1A (fuel injected, S/N 0139 & Subs)

specifications.notes: At 2700 rpm, both takeoff and max continuous, sea level standard

fuel_system.title: DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION DESCRIPTION
fuel_system.description: Main fuel tank located externally on the left-hand side of the cabin bulkhead. An optional auxiliary tank may be attached externally on the right-hand side of the cabin bulkhead. Tank capacities vary by serial number.
key_points: Main tank on left-hand side of cabin bulkhead (external)
Optional auxiliary tank on right-hand side of cabin bulkhead (external)
Main tank capacity: 35.2 US gal (S/N dependent) or 33.0 US gal
Auxiliary tank capacity: 30.0 US gal or 33.0 US gal (S/N dependent)

flight_controls.title: DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION DESCRIPTION
flight_controls.description: Mechanically linked solid-type cyclic and collective control systems using tubular push-pull rods. Tail rotor control uses cables and pulleys in one link of an otherwise solid tubular push-pull rod system. Collective and cyclic controls are provided for the pilot on the right side; pedals are adjustable.
key_points: Cyclic and collective systems are mechanically linked solid type using tubular push-pull rods
Tail rotor system uses cables and pulleys in one link, otherwise solid push-pull rods
Pilot position on RIGHT side with cyclic stick and pedals forward, collective to left
Pedals are adjustable
Throttle is twist grip type with 130° of travel
components: Cables and pulleys (tail rotor control link)

specifications.item: Collective stick travel (full down to full up)
Throttle twist grip travel (full closed to full open)
Cyclic stick travel (full forward to full aft)
Cyclic stick travel (full left to full right)
Directional control pedal travel (full forward to full aft)

stabilizers.title: GENERAL DIMENSIONAL DATA
stabilizers.description: Fixed horizontal and vertical stabilizers at the aft end of the tailboom. The horizontal stabilizer uses NACA 0015 modified airfoil with 35° dihedral and 9.8° incidence. The vertical stabilizer uses a symmetrical airfoil.
key_points: Horizontal stabilizer: NACA 0015 modified, 35° dihedral, 9.8° incidence
Vertical stabilizer: symmetrical airfoil, 1.00 in thick fin, triangular planform (tip chord 0.0)
Both stabilizers supported at aft end of tailboom

specifications.item: Horizontal stabilizer span to tailboom CL
